title: Sickle cell, ITP and immunodeficiency
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's blood or immune disorder.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for common variable immunodeficiency.

HPI
The patient is an 89-year-old female who presents for a scheduled evaluation of her common variable immunodeficiency. She reports that she has been tolerating her monthly immunoglobulin infusions well without significant adverse reactions. She denies any new fevers, persistent infections, or respiratory symptoms since her last visit. She remains stable on her current maintenance regimen.

Medication List
- Immunoglobulin, monthly infusion
- Multivitamin

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented to person, place, and time. She appears well-nourished and in no acute distress. Skin is warm and dry. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs.

Assessment
1. Common variable immunodeficiency. The patient is stable and continuing to respond well to her monthly immunoglobulin infusions.

Plan
1. Continue monthly immunoglobulin infusions as scheduled.
2. Continue current multivitamin.
3. Follow up in the clinic in three months for routine monitoring.

Electronically signed, P. O'Brien, MD, 05/14/2026
